caption: The drawing depicts a cast iron balcony railing, illustrated in black ink on a beige or off-white background. The railing features an ornate design with a repeating pattern of vertical balusters, each topped with a circle and decorated with floral and geometric motifs. In the center, there is a large circular medallion framed with additional scrollwork and intricate floral patterns, creating a focal point. The top rail is adorned with a repeating row of symmetrical floral designs, and the bottom section of the railing sits on a floor composed of evenly spaced horizontal planks. The sides of the balcony are framed with vertical lines indicative of architectural columns or supports. The label "CAST IRON BALCONY RAILING" is written in uppercase hand lettering below the illustration. The entire composition is symmetrical and precisely rendered with fine, consistent linework.
title: Cast Iron Balcony Rail
